title: [Analysis of influencing factors associated with cirrhosis in patients with indeterminate-phase chronic hepatitis B].
abstract: Objective: To analyze the influencing factors associated with cirrhosis in patients with indeterminate-phase chronic hepatitis B (CHB). Methods: CHB patients in the indeterminate phase who did not receive antiviral treatment at the Senior Department of Hepatology, the Fifth Medical Center of Chinese PLA General Hospital between January 2020 and June 2025 were retrospectively included. According to whether cirrhosis had occurred, the patients were divided into the cirrhosis group (patients diagnosed with cirrhosis) and the non-cirrhosis group (patients not diagnosed with cirrhosis). Differences in demographic characteristics, virological indicators, routine blood parameters, and liver function-related clinical indicators were compared between the two groups. Restricted cubic spline analysis was used to determine the threshold values of platelet and age in relation to cirrhosis risk. A multivariate logistic regression model was used to analyze factors associated with cirrhosis in patients with indeterminate-phase CHB. Results: A total of 422 patients was included. There were 182 patients in the cirrhosis group with 128 males and 54 females, aged (47±9) years; and 240 patients in the non-cirrhosis group with 146 males and 94 females, aged (43±11) years. Patients in the cirrhosis group were older than those in the non-cirrhosis group (P<0.001). The distribution of HBV DNA differed statistically between the two groups (P=0.002). Compared with the non-cirrhosis group, the cirrhosis group had a lower proportion of low HBV DNA load (<2×103 U/ml) [14.8% (27/182) vs 29.6% (71/240), P<0.001] and a higher proportion of intermediate HBV DNA load (2×103-<2×107 U/ml) [67.6% (123/182) vs 57.5% (138/240), P=0.032], whereas the proportion of high HBV DNA load (≥2×107 U/ml) did not differ significantly [17.6% (32/182) vs 12.9% (31/240), P=0.160]. Platelet count [M (Q1, Q3), 158 (94, 199)×109/L vs 205 (171, 244)×109/L] and HBsAg levels (log HBsAg) [2.9 (2.5, 3.2) vs 3.1 (2.7, 3.6) U/ml] were lower in the cirrhosis group than those in the non-cirrhosis group (both P<0.001). Restricted cubic spline analysis showed non-linear associations of platelet count and age with cirrhosis risk in patients with indeterminate-phase CHB (P<0.05). The corresponding threshold values were 45 years and 180×109/L of age and platelet count, respectively. Multivariate logistic regression analysis showed that decreased HBsAg levels (log HbsAg) (OR=1.99, 95%CI: 1.35-2.93), HBV DNA between 2×103 and<2×107 U/ml (OR=2.12, 95%CI: 1.18-3.81), HBV DNA≥2×107 U/ml (OR=4.02, 95%CI: 1.80-9.00), age≥45 years (OR=2.06, 95%CI: 1.32-3.24), and platelet count<180×109/L (OR=3.99, 95%CI: 2.55-6.23) were associated with cirrhosis in patients with indeterminate-phase CHB. Conclusion: Age≥45 years, platelet count<180×109/L, HBV DNA≥2×103 U/ml and decreased HBsAg are influencing factors for the progression to cirrhosis in patients with indeterminate-phase CHB who did not receive antiviral treatment.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) in the indeterminate phase poses a risk of progression to cirrhosis, yet factors influencing this transition remain insufficiently characterized. The study aimed to identify demographic, virological, and clinical indicators associated with cirrhosis in untreated patients with indeterminate-phase CHB.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This retrospective study enrolled 422 patients with indeterminate-phase CHB who had not received antiviral treatment at a single tertiary center in China between January 2020 and June 2025. Patients were stratified into a cirrhosis group (n=182) and a non-cirrhosis group (n=240) based on cirrhosis diagnosis.

Restricted cubic spline analysis was used to assess non-linear associations of platelet count and age with cirrhosis risk, and multivariate logistic regression identified factors independently associated with cirrhosis.

title_zh: 不确定期慢性乙型肝炎患者肝硬化影响因素分析
source_body_en: Objective: To analyze the influencing factors associated with cirrhosis in patients with indeterminate-phase chronic hepatitis B (CHB). Methods: CHB patients in the indeterminate phase who did not receive antiviral treatment at the Senior Department of Hepatology, the Fifth Medical Center of Chinese PLA General Hospital between January 2020 and June 2025 were retrospectively included. According to whether cirrhosis had occurred, the patients were divided into the cirrhosis group (patients diagnosed with cirrhosis) and the non-cirrhosis group (patients not diagnosed with cirrhosis). Differences in demographic characteristics, virological indicators, routine blood parameters, and liver function-related clinical indicators were compared between the two groups. Restricted cubic spline analysis was used to determine the threshold values of platelet and age in relation to cirrhosis risk. A multivariate logistic regression model was used to analyze factors associated with cirrhosis in patients with indeterminate-phase CHB. Results: A total of 422 patients was included. There were 182 patients in the cirrhosis group with 128 males and 54 females, aged (47±9) years; and 240 patients in the non-cirrhosis group with 146 males and 94 females, aged (43±11) years. Patients in the cirrhosis group were older than those in the non-cirrhosis group (P<0.001). The distribution of HBV DNA differed statistically between the two groups (P=0.002). Compared with the non-cirrhosis group, the cirrhosis group had a lower proportion of low HBV DNA load (<2×103 U/ml) [14.8% (27/182) vs 29.6% (71/240), P<0.001] and a higher proportion of intermediate HBV DNA load (2×103-<2×107 U/ml) [67.6% (123/182) vs 57.5% (138/240), P=0.032], whereas the proportion of high HBV DNA load (≥2×107 U/ml) did not differ significantly [17.6% (32/182) vs 12.9% (31/240), P=0.160]. Platelet count [M (Q1, Q3), 158 (94, 199)×109/L vs 205 (171, 244)×109/L] and HBsAg levels (log HBsAg) [2.9 (2.5, 3.2) vs 3.1 (2.7, 3.6) U/ml] were lower in the cirrhosis group than those in the non-cirrhosis group (both P<0.001). Restricted cubic spline analysis showed non-linear associations of platelet count and age with cirrhosis risk in patients with indeterminate-phase CHB (P<0.05). The corresponding threshold values were 45 years and 180×109/L of age and platelet count, respectively. Multivariate logistic regression analysis showed that decreased HBsAg levels (log HbsAg) (OR=1.99, 95%CI: 1.35-2.93), HBV DNA between 2×103 and<2×107 U/ml (OR=2.12, 95%CI: 1.18-3.81), HBV DNA≥2×107 U/ml (OR=4.02, 95%CI: 1.80-9.00), age≥45 years (OR=2.06, 95%CI: 1.32-3.24), and platelet count<180×109/L (OR=3.99, 95%CI: 2.55-6.23) were associated with cirrhosis in patients with indeterminate-phase CHB. Conclusion: Age≥45 years, platelet count<180×109/L, HBV DNA≥2×103 U/ml and decreased HBsAg are influencing factors for the progression to cirrhosis in patients with indeterminate-phase CHB who did not receive antiviral treatment.

title: Validation of a Point-Of-Care Ultrasound for Hepatitis Among Front-Line Healthcare Workers Managing Chronic Hepatitis B Virus Infection in Zambia.
abstract: To close gaps in implementing care of people with hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in resource-limited settings, we evaluated the accuracy of a novel liver point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) protocol for hepatitis (PUSH) among front-line non-radiology healthcare workers in Zambia. At University Teaching Hospital in Lusaka, Zambia, from March to June 2024, we trained four nurses and six physicians with experience in HBV management, but not in ultrasound (US), in the PUSH protocol, which includes visualizing the liver in three windows (epigastric, subcostal and right transcostal) to identify cirrhosis-suggestive features and liver lesions suspicious for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Then, consecutive adult participants with chronic hepatitis B (PWHB) alone or HBV/HIV coinfection underwent PUSH with operators blinded to clinical data. We evaluated the accuracy of PUSH for significant fibrosis and cirrhosis using transient elastography (TE) as the reference standard test (RST) and for liver lesions that were possible HCC using a comprehensive abdominal ultrasound by an experienced radiographer as the RST. Nonparametric analysis of the receiver operating curve (ROC) for PUSH was adjusted for operator type (doctor vs. nurse), sex and HIV status. Among 197 PWHBs analysed, 69.5% were taking HBV antivirals and 27.9% had HBV/HIV. According to RSTs, 17.7% of PWHBs had significant fibrosis, 11.6% had cirrhosis and 3.5% had liver lesions. PUSH had low accuracy for significant fibrosis, with sensitivity of 8.3% (17.5-41.4), specificity of 100.0% (96.1-100) and an area under the curve (AUROC) of 0.54 (0.43-0.65), moderate accuracy for cirrhosis, with sensitivity of 60.9% (38.5-80.3), specificity of 97.7% (94.2-99.4) and AUROC of 0.79 (0.69-0.89), and higher accuracy for liver lesions, with 85.7% (42.1-99.6) sensitivity, 98.4% (95.5-99.7) specificity, AUROC of 0.92 (0.78-1.00). After an expedited training, front-line nurses and physicians treating HBV in Zambia were able to use PUSH to diagnose cirrhosis with moderate accuracy and liver lesions with high accuracy, although confidence intervals around performance estimates were wide. Liver POCUS including PUSH may be useful in HBV management when laboratory systems and TE are lacking.

source_records.abstract: To close gaps in implementing care of people with hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in resource-limited settings, we evaluated the accuracy of a novel liver point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) protocol for hepatitis (PUSH) among front-line non-radiology healthcare workers in Zambia. At University Teaching Hospital in Lusaka, Zambia, from March to June 2024, we trained four nurses and six physicians with experience in HBV management, but not in ultrasound (US), in the PUSH protocol, which includes visualizing the liver in three windows (epigastric, subcostal and right transcostal) to identify cirrhosis-suggestive features and liver lesions suspicious for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Then, consecutive adult participants with chronic hepatitis B (PWHB) alone or HBV/HIV coinfection underwent PUSH with operators blinded to clinical data. We evaluated the accuracy of PUSH for significant fibrosis and cirrhosis using transient elastography (TE) as the reference standard test (RST) and for liver lesions that were possible HCC using a comprehensive abdominal ultrasound by an experienced radiographer as the RST. Nonparametric analysis of the receiver operating curve (ROC) for PUSH was adjusted for operator type (doctor vs. nurse), sex and HIV status. After an expedited training, front-line nurses and physicians treating HBV in Zambia were able to use PUSH to diagnose cirrhosis with moderate accuracy and liver lesions with high accuracy, although confidence intervals around performance estimates were wide. Liver POCUS including PUSH may be useful in HBV management when laboratory systems and TE are lacking.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于诊断访问障碍,慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 感染在资源有限的环境中仍然管理不善,这促使需要准确的护理点工具。该研究旨在评估新型肝脏即时超声 (POCUS) 方案 (PUSH) 是否能够准确识别赞比亚一线医护人员管理的慢性乙肝成人患者中的肝硬化和肝细胞癌 (HCC)。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024 年 3 月至 6 月,在赞比亚卢萨卡的大学教学医院,四名具有 HBV 管理经验但没有接受过超声培训的护士和六名医生接受了 PUSH 方案的培训,该方案在三个窗口中可视化肝脏,以检测肝硬化提示特征和 HCC 可疑病变。连续患有慢性 HBV 或 HBV/HIV 双重感染的成年人在不了解临床数据的情况下接受了 PUSH。
elements_zh.methods: 以瞬时弹性成像 (TE) 作为参考标准评估显着纤维化和肝硬化的 PUSH 准确性,同时由经验丰富的放射技师将肝脏病变与综合腹部超声进行比较。根据操作者类型、性别和 HIV 状态进行调整的非参数受试者工作曲线 (ROC) 分析用于评估诊断性能。
elements_zh.main_results: 根据参考标准,197 名参与者中,17.7% 患有明显纤维化,11.6% 患有肝硬化,3.5% 患有肝脏病变。PUSH 对显着纤维化的准确性较低(敏感性 8.3%,特异性 100.0%,AUROC 0.54),对肝硬化的准确性中等(敏感性 60.9%,特异性 97.7%,AUROC 0.79),对肝脏病变的准确性较高(敏感性 85.7%,特异性 98.4%,AUROC 0.92)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,经过短暂训练后,PUSH 可以以中等准确度诊断肝硬化,并以较高准确度诊断肝脏病变,这突显了其在实验室系统和 TE 不可用的情况下的潜在用途。他们强调了在资源有限的环境中验证非放射科医生执行的 POCUS 方案针对 HBV 相关并发症的新颖性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现谨慎地表明,PUSH 可以支持分散的 HBV 护理,使一线提供者能够在无法获得高级诊断的情况下筛查肝硬化和 HCC,从而有可能改善赞比亚的早期检测和转诊。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的样本量较小,性能估计的置信区间较宽,限制了精度,而且单中心设计限制了普遍性。尽管存在这些局限性,但由于明确的目标特异性方法和临床相关结果,证据是温和的。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现谨慎地表明,PUSH 可以支持分散的 HBV 护理,使一线提供者能够在无法获得高级诊断的情况下筛查肝硬化和 HCC,从而有可能改善赞比亚的早期检测和转诊。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的样本量较小,性能估计的置信区间较宽,限制了精度,而且单中心设计限制了普遍性。尽管存在这些局限性,但由于明确的目标特异性方法和临床相关结果,证据是温和的。

title: The BTLA/HVEM axis as a key regulator for stratified functional cure in chronic hepatitis B
abstract: Background Functional cure rates in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remain below 10% after long-term nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) therapy, and PD-1/PD-L1 blockade achieves HBsAg clearance in approximately 30% of selected patients with low baseline HBsAg (≤100 IU/mL). This shortfall reflects an oversimplified view of T-cell exhaustion that neglects nonredundant checkpoints operating in parallel with PD-1. Main arguments We synthesize emerging evidence (2019–2025) to position the B and T lymphocyte attenuator (BTLA)/herpesvirus entry mediator (HVEM) axis as an emerging candidate hub for layered therapeutic strategies in HBV infection. BTLA preferentially recruits SHP-1 (versus PD-1-predominant SHP-2) and signals via PI3K–AKT to sustain terminal exhaustion independently of PD-1 status. BTLA preferentially recruits SHP-1 (Src homology region 2 domain-containing phosphatase-1) [versus PD-1-predominant SHP-2 (Src homology region 2 domain-containing phosphatase-2)] and signals via PI3K–AKT to constrain TPEX proliferation and effector differentiation independently of PD-1 status. In CHB, BTLA is upregulated on peripheral and intrahepatic CD4+ and CD8+ T cells, correlating with ALT/AST and histologic activity; however, this correlation should be interpreted cautiously, as elevated liver enzymes primarily reflect immune-mediated hepatocellular injury during active inflammation rather than purely antiviral immune dysfunction. In HBV-related acute-on-chronic liver failure (HBV-ACLF), CD4+ T-cell BTLA expression independently predicts 90-day mortality and secondary infections. Soluble BTLA has emerged as a candidate minimally invasive biomarker for risk stratification in resource-limited settings. Conclusion Under low antigen load following long-term NA suppression (HBsAg <100 IU/mL), biomarker-guided combination therapy targeting BTLA/HVEM alongside PD-1 may expand functional cure rates beyond the ceiling of single-checkpoint blockade. We outline an adaptive Phase I trial concept with predefined stratification thresholds to enable reproducible translation in HBV-endemic regions.

abstract_zh: 背景 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 中的 功能性治愈 率在长期核苷(酸)类似物 (NA) 治疗后仍低于 10%,并且 PD-1/PD-L1 阻断在大约 30% 的低基线 HBsAg (≤100 IU/mL) 选定患者中实现 HBsAg 清除。这种不足反映了对 T 细胞耗竭的过于简单化的看法,忽略了与 PD-1 并行运行的非冗余检查点。主要论点 我们综合了新出现的证据(2019-2025),将 B 淋巴细胞和 T 淋巴细胞衰减因子 (BTLA)/疱疹病毒进入介导因子 (HVEM) 轴定位为 HBV 感染分层治疗策略的新兴候选中心。BTLA 优先招募 SHP-1(相对于以 PD-1 为主的 SHP-2)并通过 PI3K-AKT 发出信号,以独立于 PD-1 状态维持终末衰竭。BTLA 优先招募 SHP-1(包含 Src 同源区 2 结构域的磷酸酶-1)[相对于以 PD-1 为主的 SHP-2(包含 Src 同源区 2 结构域的磷酸酶-2)] 并通过 PI3K–AKT 发出信号,以独立于 PD-1 状态限制 TPEX 增殖和效应器分化。在 CHB 中,外周和肝内 CD4+ 和 CD8+ T 细胞的 BTLA 上调,与 ALT/AST 和组织学活性相关;然而,这种相关性应谨慎解释,因为肝酶升高主要反映了活动性炎症期间免疫介导的肝细胞损伤,而不是纯粹的 抗病毒药物 免疫功能障碍。在 HBV 相关慢性肝衰竭 (HBV-ACLF) 中,CD4+ T 细胞 BTLA 表达独立预测 90 天 死亡率 和继发感染。可溶性 BTLA 已成为资源有限环境中风险分层的候选微创生物标志物。结论 在长期 NA 抑制后的低抗原负荷(HBsAg <100 IU/mL)下,生物标志物引导下的 BTLA/HVEM 联合 PD-1 联合治疗可能会将 功能性治愈 率扩大到单检查点阻断的上限之外。我们概述了具有预定义分层阈值的适应性 I 期试验概念,以实现 HBV 流行地区的可重复翻译。

title: Burden of Hepatitis B virus infection among pregnant women attending antenatal care clinic at the University of Gondar Comprehensive Specialized Hospital, Northwest Ethiopia
abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection poses a serious public health challenge globally. Despite HBV vaccination providing over 95% protection against chronic infection, mother-to-child transmission remains the leading cause of a higher prevalence of HBV infection. Thus, this study aimed to determine the magnitude of HBV infection among pregnant women visiting an antenatal care clinic in northwest Ethiopia. A facility-based cross-sectional study was conducted among 292 pregnant women from May to August 2023 at the University of Gondar Comprehensive Specialized Hospital antenatal care (ANC) clinic, Gondar, Northwest Ethiopia. A simple random sampling technique was employed to recruit pregnant women. Sociodemographic, clinical, and other factors were collected using a structured questionnaire. Five milliliters of venous blood were collected using a Vacutainer tube. Serum samples were isolated and tested for HBsAg using a one-step HBsAg test strip, with further confirmation through an Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay (ELISA) test kit. Data were analyzed using SPSS version 26, and the association between HBV infection and predictor variables was computed using a logistic regression analysis. A p-value of ≤ 0.05 with a 95% confidence interval was considered statistically significant. The age range of pregnant women was from 18 to 44 years, with a mean (SD) age of 28.3 (5.5) years. The overall prevalence of HBV infection among pregnant women was 3.1% (95% CI: 1.4–5.8). An intermediate prevalence of HBV infection was found among pregnant women. To reduce the burden of HBV infection in these study groups, it is critical to enhance public awareness, expand HBV vaccination programs, increase HBV screening, and provide early treatment.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major public health problem globally, and mother-to-child transmission persists as a leading driver of chronic infection despite high vaccine efficacy. The study addressed the knowledge gap regarding the burden of HBV infection among pregnant women in a specific Ethiopian setting.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A facility-based cross-sectional study was conducted among 292 pregnant women attending the antenatal care clinic at the University of Gondar Comprehensive Specialized Hospital from May to August 2023 in Gondar, Northwest Ethiopia. Participants were recruited using a simple random sampling technique.
analysis.methods: Sociodemographic, clinical, and other factors were collected via a structured questionnaire. Five milliliters of venous blood were collected and serum samples were isolated and tested for HBsAg using a one-step HBsAg test strip, with confirmation by ELISA. Data were analyzed using SPSS version 26, and logistic regression was used to assess associations between HBV infection and predictor variables.
analysis.main_results: The overall prevalence of HBV infection among pregnant women was 3.1% (95% CI: 1.4–5.8), indicating an intermediate prevalence level.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the intermediate prevalence as evidence of ongoing HBV transmission risk in this population and highlighted the need for enhanced screening and vaccination strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support strengthening HBV screening programs, expanding vaccination coverage, and improving public awareness to reduce mother-to-child transmission in antenatal care settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The cross-sectional design and single-center sampling limit causal inference and generalizability, and reliance on HBsAg detection alone may underestimate occult HBV infection, warranting cautious interpretation of the evidence strength as moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study assessed the burden of hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection among 292 pregnant women attending an antenatal care clinic in Gondar, Northwest Ethiopia, from May to August 2023. Using a cross-sectional design, the authors found an overall HBV prevalence of 3.1% (95% CI: 1.4–5.8), classifying it as intermediate. Data were collected via structured questionnaires and blood samples tested for HBsAg using rapid test strips and ELISA, with logistic regression used to analyze associations. The authors interpret the intermediate prevalence as indicative of ongoing transmission risk and emphasize the need for enhanced screening, vaccination, and public awareness to reduce mother-to-child transmission. However, the single-center, cross-sectional design and reliance on HBsAg detection alone limit causal inference and may underestimate occult infection, reducing confidence in the findings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染仍然是全球主要的公共卫生问题,尽管 疫苗 疗效很高,但母婴 传播 仍然是慢性感染的主要驱动因素。该研究解决了埃塞俄比亚特定环境下孕妇乙型肝炎病毒感染负担的知识差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对 2023 年 5 月至 2023 年 8 月在埃塞俄比亚西北部贡德尔的贡德尔大学综合专科医院产前护理诊所就诊的 292 名孕妇进行了一项基于设施的横断面研究。使用简单的随机抽样技术招募参与者。
elements_zh.methods: 通过结构化调查问卷收集社会人口统计学、临床和其他因素。采集5毫升静脉血,分离血清样本,并使用一步式HBsAg试纸条检测HBsAg,并通过ELISA进行确认。使用 SPSS 26 版对数据进行分析,并使用逻辑回归来评估 HBV 感染与预测变量之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: 孕妇中 HBV 感染的总体 患病率 为 3.1%(95% CI:1.4–5.8),表明 患病率 处于中等水平。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将中间 患病率 解释为该人群中持续存在 HBV 传播 风险的证据,并强调需要加强筛查和 疫苗接种 策略。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持加强 HBV 筛查计划、扩大 传播 覆盖范围并提高公众意识,以减少产前护理机构中的母婴 传播。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 横断面设计和单中心抽样限制了因果推断和普遍性,并且仅依赖 HBsAg 检测可能会低估隐匿性 HBV 感染,因此需要谨慎地将证据强度解释为中等。

title: Association between the IL-35 rs583911 polymorphism and hepatocellular carcinoma risk in patients infected with chronic hepatitis B virus
abstract: Abstract Background The immunoregulatory cytokine interleukin (IL)-35 has been implicated in the pathogenesis of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Here, we explored the association between single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) in the IL-35 gene and the occurrence of HCC in patients with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV). Methods We selected 39 patients with chronic hepatitis B (HBV) and 52 patients with HBV-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) as the case groups, along with 42 healthy individuals as the control group. We genotyped five IL-35-related single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) and analyzed their association with HCC risk. In addition, serum IL-35 levels, lymphocyte counts, and regulatory T cell (Treg) frequencies were measured in peripheral blood across all groups. Results The frequency of the rs583911 AA genotype tended to increase from healthy controls (4.8%) to patients with chronic HBV (10.3%) to patients with HCC (21.2%) (P for trend = 0.03). When patients with HCC were compared to non-HCC controls (healthy controls + chronic HBV carriers), the rs583911 AA genotype was associated with HCC risk (OR = 3.35; 95% CI: 1.17–9.61, P = 0.020). After adjusting for age, sex, cirrhosis status, and antiviral therapy, the association was no longer statistically significant (adjusted P = 0.085). Serum IL-35 levels were significantly elevated in both the HBV and the HCC groups compared with those in the control group ( P < 0.001), with no significant difference between the HBV and the HCC groups ( P = 0.434). Within the HCC subgroup, patients with the AA genotype tended to have higher IL-35 levels ( P = 0.047). Flow cytometry analysis of a subset of samples (6 controls, 6 patients with HBV, and 28 patients with HCC) revealed that the number of Treg cells was greater in patients with HCC than in those with HBV ( P = 0.038). Conclusion Our findings suggest a potential association between the rs583911 AA genotype and HBV-related HCC risk. However, these exploratory findings did not remain statistically significant after rigorous adjustment for multiple comparisons and potential confounders; therefore, validation in larger, independent cohorts is needed.

title_zh: IL-35 rs583911多态性与慢性乙型肝炎病毒感染患者肝癌风险的相关性
source_body_en: Abstract Background The immunoregulatory cytokine interleukin (IL)-35 has been implicated in the pathogenesis of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). We genotyped five IL-35-related single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) and analyzed their association with HCC risk. In addition, serum IL-35 levels, lymphocyte counts, and regulatory T cell (Treg) frequencies were measured in peripheral blood across all groups. Results The frequency of the rs583911 AA genotype tended to increase from healthy controls (4.8%) to patients with chronic HBV (10.3%) to patients with HCC (21.2%) (P for trend = 0.03). When patients with HCC were compared to non-HCC controls (healthy controls + chronic HBV carriers), the rs583911 AA genotype was associated with HCC risk (OR = 3.35; 95% CI: 1.17–9.61, P = 0.020). After adjusting for age, sex, cirrhosis status, and antiviral therapy, the association was no longer statistically significant (adjusted P = 0.085). Serum IL-35 levels were significantly elevated in both the HBV and the HCC groups compared with those in the control group ( P < 0.001), with no significant difference between the HBV and the HCC groups ( P = 0.434). Within the HCC subgroup, patients with the AA genotype tended to have higher IL-35 levels ( P = 0.047). Flow cytometry analysis of a subset of samples (6 controls, 6 patients with HBV, and 28 patients with HCC) revealed that the number of Treg cells was greater in patients with HCC than in those with HBV ( P = 0.038). Conclusion Our findings suggest a potential association between the rs583911 AA genotype and HBV-related HCC risk. However, these exploratory findings did not remain statistically significant after rigorous adjustment for multiple comparisons and potential confounders; therefore, validation in larger, independent cohorts is needed.
abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 免疫调节细胞因子白细胞介素 (IL)-35 与肝细胞癌 (HCC) 的 发病机制 有关。在这里,我们探讨了 IL-35 基因中的单核苷酸多态性 (SNP) 与 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 患者发生 HCC 之间的关联。方法选取39例慢性乙型肝炎(HBV)患者和52例HBV相关肝细胞癌(HCC)患者作为病例组,42例健康人作为对照组。我们对 5 个 IL-35 相关单核苷酸多态性 (SNP) 进行了基因分型,并分析了它们与 HCC 风险的关联。此外,还测量了所有组外周血中的血清 IL-35 水平、淋巴细胞计数和调节性 T 细胞 (Treg) 频率。结果 rs583911 AA基因型的频率从健康对照(4.8%)到慢性乙型肝炎患者(10.3%)再到肝癌患者(21.2%)呈增加趋势(趋势P = 0.03)。当 HCC 患者与非 HCC 对照(健康对照 + 慢性 HBV 携带者)进行比较时,rs583911 AA 基因型与 HCC 风险相关(OR = 3.35;95% CI:1.17–9.61,P = 0.020)。调整年龄、性别、肝硬化状态和 抗病毒药物 治疗后,相关性不再具有统计学意义(调整后的 P = 0.085)。与对照组相比,HBV 组和 HCC 组血清 IL-35 水平均显着升高( P < 0.001),而 HBV 组和 HCC 组之间差异无统计学意义( P = 0.434)。在 HCC 亚组中,AA 基因型患者的 IL-35 水平往往较高(P = 0.047)。对一组样本(6 名对照、6 名 HBV 患者和 28 名 HCC 患者)进行流式细胞术分析显示,HCC 患者的 Treg 细胞数量高于 HBV 患者(P = 0.038)。结论 我们的研究结果表明 rs583911 AA 基因型与 HBV 相关 HCC 风险之间存在潜在关联。然而,在对多重比较和潜在混杂因素进行严格调整后,这些探索性发现并没有保持统计显着性;因此,需要在更大、独立的 队列研究 中进行验证。

title: Implementation gaps and policy priorities for viral hepatitis elimination in India
abstract: Viral hepatitis remains a major public health challenge globally, with India bearing nearly 11.6% of the world’s chronic infections. To align with the World Health Organization’s target of eliminating viral hepatitis as a public health threat by 2030, India launched the National Viral Hepatitis Control Programme (NVHCP), which employs virus-specific strategies including elimination of hepatitis C virus (HCV), reduction of chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) burden, and strengthened prevention of enterically transmitted hepatitis. Through decentralization of services and provision of free generic direct-acting antivirals (DAAs), the programme has achieved substantial progress, with HCV cure rates exceeding 90% among treated individuals. Despite these gains, several implementation challenges continue to impede progress toward elimination targets. Critical gaps persist in the diagnostic cascade, including limited availability of integrated reflex viral load testing, inadequate access to HBV DNA testing, and the absence of routine hepatitis D virus (HDV) screening among HBsAg-positive individuals. Restrictive HBV treatment eligibility criteria, suboptimal hepatitis B birth-dose vaccine coverage, fragmented surveillance systems, and persistent stigma further undermine programme effectiveness. This persepective article examines the key barriers to viral hepatitis elimination in India and outlines priority policy actions. These include institutionalizing single-visit reflex molecular testing, expanding HBV treatment eligibility in accordance with the 2024 WHO guidelines, strengthening maternal antiviral prophylaxis and birth-dose vaccination strategies, improving outreach to marginalized populations, and integrating digital surveillance and patient-tracking systems to enhance continuity of care. Successful decentralized models, such as Punjab’s hepatitis programme, offer valuable lessons for scaling up effective interventions and accelerating India’s progress toward achieving its 2030 viral hepatitis elimination goals.erspective revi

To align with the World Health Organization’s target of eliminating viral hepatitis as a public health threat by 2030, India launched the National Viral Hepatitis Control Programme (NVHCP), which employs virus-specific strategies including elimination of hepatitis C virus (HCV), reduction of chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) burden, and strengthened prevention of enterically transmitted hepatitis. Through decentralization of services and provision of free generic direct-acting antivirals (DAAs), the programme has achieved substantial progress, with HCV cure rates exceeding 90% among treated individuals. Despite these gains, several implementation challenges continue to impede progress toward elimination targets. Critical gaps persist in the diagnostic cascade, including limited availability of integrated reflex viral load testing, inadequate access to HBV DNA testing, and the absence of routine hepatitis D virus (HDV) screening among HBsAg-positive individuals. Restrictive HBV treatment eligibility criteria, suboptimal hepatitis B birth-dose vaccine coverage, fragmented surveillance systems, and persistent stigma further undermine programme effectiveness. This persepective article examines the key barriers to viral hepatitis elimination in India and outlines priority policy actions. These include institutionalizing single-visit reflex molecular testing, expanding HBV treatment eligibility in accordance with the 2024 WHO guidelines, strengthening maternal antiviral prophylaxis and birth-dose vaccination strategies, improving outreach to marginalized populations, and integrating digital surveillance and patient-tracking systems to enhance continuity of care. Successful decentralized models, such as Punjab’s hepatitis programme, offer valuable lessons for scaling up effective interventions and accelerating India’s progress toward achieving its 2030 viral hepatitis elimination goals.erspective revi

title: Living-donor liver transplantation at 17 weeks gestation for hepatitis B virus-related acute liver failure with hepatic encephalopathy with emergency cesarean delivery at 34 weeks: a case report
abstract: Liver transplantation during pregnancy is rare but may be lifesaving in cases of acute liver failure occurring before fetal viability. A primigravida with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection developed HBV-related acute liver failure with grade III hepatic encephalopathy at 17 weeks gestation. Because delivery could not improve fetal survival, the multidisciplinary team prioritized transplantation while pregnancy continued. Laboratory investigations demonstrated severe thrombocytopenia and hypofibrinogenemia. Anesthetic management was guided by predefined maternal physiologic and hematologic targets to support uteroplacental perfusion and included temporary portosystemic shunting. Staged fetal ultrasonography confirmed viability. Surgery lasted 10 h 55 min, with 2,410 mL blood loss. The mother recovered. Following preterm premature rupture of membranes, breech presentation prompted an emergency cesarean delivery at 34 weeks with spinal anesthesia, followed by neonatal intensive care. This case shows that when delivery cannot offer fetal rescue, urgent transplantation and continued pregnancy can be integrated through multidisciplinary decision-making and specialized perioperative management.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了妊娠期间因 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 感染而导致的急性肝功能衰竭的临床挑战,其中胎儿存活率妨碍分娩作为一种救援策略。它探讨了是否可以在维持妊娠的同时进行活体肝移植,以优化母体和胎儿的结局。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是一位患有慢性 HBV 感染的初产妇的单 病例报告,她在妊娠 17 周时出现了 HBV 相关的急性肝功能衰竭并伴有肝性脑病。该病例需要多学科治疗,包括在继续妊娠期间进行活体肝移植,然后在 34 周时进行紧急剖腹产。
elements_zh.methods: 麻醉和手术管理涉及预先确定的母体生理和血液学目标,以支持子宫胎盘灌注,包括临时门体分流。通过移植优先考虑母体的生存能力,并在整个围手术期通过分阶段的胎儿超声检查来确认母体的生存能力。
elements_zh.main_results: 实验室检查显示严重的血小板减少症和低纤维蛋白原血症。手术持续了 10 小时 55 分钟,预计失血量为 2,410 毫升。母亲已完全康复,34周时紧急剖腹产后,由于胎膜早破和臀位,新生儿需要新生儿重症监护。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将此案例解读为,当分娩无法挽救胎儿时,通过专门的多学科和围手术期管理,紧急肝移植联合继续妊娠是可行的。新颖之处在于在怀孕期间进行移植的综合方法,以稳定母体与乙型肝炎相关的急性肝衰竭,同时保留胎儿的活力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该病例凸显了妊娠期肝移植治疗乙型肝炎相关急性肝功能衰竭的潜力,可以在分娩不可行的情况下提高孕产妇生存率,同时又不影响胎儿结局。它强调需要专门的中心和方案来管理此类高风险妊娠。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于单个 病例报告,这限制了普遍性并排除了因果推理。尽管描述了详细的围手术期管理,但缺乏对照组和对单中心经验的依赖将证据强度降低至低水平。

title: Rare HBV Genotypes and Clinically Relevant Mutations of HBV and HCV During the COVID-19 Pandemic in a National Reference Outpatient Clinic in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
abstract: Chronic hepatitis B and C are major causes of cirrhosis, hepatocellular carcinoma, and liver-related mortality worldwide. The genetic diversity of hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) influences disease progression, diagnosis, vaccine response, and antiviral treatment. Periods of healthcare disruption, such as the COVID-19 pandemic, reinforce the importance of molecular surveillance to monitor viral genotypes and clinically relevant mutations. This study described the distribution of HBV and HCV genotypes and mutations in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, during the COVID-19 pandemic. A cross-sectional study included 25 patients (15 HBV and 10 HCV) recruited between 2020 and 2022. Viral nucleic acids were amplified and sequenced by Sanger methodology, and mutations were analyzed using the Geno2pheno platform. HBV genotype A predominated (67%), comprising subgenotypes A1 (40%) and A2 (27%), followed by the rare genotypes B1 (13%), F2 (13%), and G (7%). Among HCV-infected individuals, genotypes 1a (40%) and 1b (30%) predominated, followed by genotypes 4 (20%) and 2 (10%). HBV immune escape mutations (Y100C and T126S) and unusual insertions in the S and RT domains were identified. In HCV, the substitutions C316Y, C316N, and S282R were detected. These findings highlight the importance of molecular surveillance for detecting clinically relevant viral variants.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis B remains a leading cause of cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma globally, and its genetic diversity affects disease progression, diagnosis, and treatment response. The study was motivated by the need to assess HBV genotype distribution and clinically relevant mutations during the COVID-19 pandemic, a period of healthcare disruption that may have impacted molecular surveillance.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted in a national reference outpatient clinic in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, enrolling 25 patients (15 HBV and 10 HCV) between 2020 and 2022. Viral nucleic acids were amplified and sequenced using Sanger methodology, and mutations were analyzed with the Geno2pheno platform.
analysis.methods: The study focused on HBV and HCV genotypes and clinically relevant mutations.
analysis.main_results: HBV genotype A predominated (67%), comprising subgenotypes A1 (40%) and A2 (27%), followed by rare genotypes B1 (13%), F2 (13%), and G (7%). HBV immune escape mutations (Y100C and T126S) and unusual insertions in the S and RT domains were identified.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors highlight the detection of rare HBV genotypes and clinically relevant mutations, underscoring the importance of molecular surveillance during periods of healthcare disruption. The identification of immune escape mutations and unusual insertions represents a novel contribution to local HBV molecular epidemiology.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings support the need for ongoing molecular surveillance of HBV to inform diagnosis, vaccine strategies, and antiviral treatment decisions, particularly in settings with limited prior genotype data.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The small sample size (n=15 HBV cases) and single-center design limit generalizability and statistical power. The evidence strength is moderate due to the descriptive nature of the study and absence of longitudinal follow-up.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study from a national reference clinic in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, assessed HBV and HCV genotypes and clinically relevant mutations during 2020–2022. Among 15 HBV-infected patients, genotype A predominated (67%), including rare subgenotypes B1, F2, and G, alongside immune escape mutations (Y100C, T126S) and unusual insertions in S and RT domains. The study underscores the value of molecular surveillance during pandemic-era healthcare disruptions for informing diagnosis and treatment strategies. Limitations include a small sample size and single-center design, yielding moderate-strength evidence.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎 仍然是全球肝硬化和肝细胞癌的主要原因,其遗传多样性影响疾病进展、诊断 和 治疗 反应。这项研究的动机是需要评估 COVID-19 大流行期间的 HBV 基因型分布和临床相关的 突变,这段医疗保健中断的时期可能会影响分子 监测。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项横断面研究在巴西里约热内卢的国家参考门诊诊所进行,2020年至2022年间招募了25名患者(15名乙肝患者和10名丙肝患者)。使用Sanger方法对病毒核酸进行扩增和测序,并使用Geno2pheno平台对突变进行分析。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究重点关注 HBV 和 HCV 基因型以及临床相关的 突变。
elements_zh.main_results: HBV 基因型 A 占主导地位 (67%),包括亚基因型 A1 (40%) 和 A2 (27%),其次是罕见基因型 B1 (13%)、F2 (13%) 和 G (7%)。鉴定出 HBV 免疫逃逸 突变(Y100C 和 T126S)以及 S 和 RT 结构域中的异常插入。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者强调了罕见 HBV 基因型和临床相关 监测 的检测,强调了分子 监测 在医疗保健中断期间的重要性。免疫逃逸 突变 和异常插入的鉴定代表了对局部 HBV 分子 流行病学 的新贡献。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持需要持续进行 HBV 分子 监测 来为 诊断、疫苗 策略和 抗病毒药物 治疗 决策提供信息,特别是在先前基因型数据有限的情况下。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 小样本量(n = 15 HBV 病例)和单中心设计限制了普遍性和统计功效。由于研究的描述性和缺乏纵向随访,证据强度中等。

Periods of healthcare disruption, such as the COVID-19 pandemic, reinforce the importance of molecular surveillance to monitor viral genotypes and clinically relevant mutations. This study described the distribution of HBV and HCV genotypes and mutations in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, during the COVID-19 pandemic. A cross-sectional study included 25 patients (15 HBV and 10 HCV) recruited between 2020 and 2022. Viral nucleic acids were amplified and sequenced by Sanger methodology, and mutations were analyzed using the Geno2pheno platform. HBV genotype A predominated (67%), comprising subgenotypes A1 (40%) and A2 (27%), followed by the rare genotypes B1 (13%), F2 (13%), and G (7%). Among HCV-infected individuals, genotypes 1a (40%) and 1b (30%) predominated, followed by genotypes 4 (20%) and 2 (10%). HBV immune escape mutations (Y100C and T126S) and unusual insertions in the S and RT domains were identified. In HCV, the substitutions C316Y, C316N, and S282R were detected. These findings highlight the importance of molecular surveillance for detecting clinically relevant viral variants.

title: Post-vaccination hepatitis B seroprotection among kidney transplant recipients in Saudi Arabia: a retrospective cohort study
abstract: Background: Evidence regarding post-vaccination hepatitis B virus (HBV) seroprotection among kidney transplant recipients in Saudi Arabia remains limited. This study estimated the prevalence of seroprotection and evaluated factors associated with vaccine nonresponse. Methods: This single-center retrospective cohort study included adult kidney transplant recipients followed at Prince Sultan Military Medical City, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, who had documented hepatitis B vaccination and subsequent quantitative measurement of antibodies to hepatitis B surface antigen (anti-HBs). Seroprotection was defined as an anti-HBs concentration of at least 10 mIU/ml. Participant characteristics were compared according to seroprotection status. Multivariable logistic regression was used to evaluate associations between non-seroprotection and total number of hepatitis B vaccine doses. Results: Among 100 kidney transplant recipients, the mean (SD) age was 41.4 (15.2) years, and 66 participants (66.0%) were male. Overall, 69 recipients achieved seroprotection (69.0%; 95% CI, 59.4-77.2%), whereas 31 (31.0%) remained non-seroprotected. Vaccine dose category differed significantly by seroprotection status (p=0.014); 80.6% of non-seroprotected recipients had received only 1 to 2 doses compared with 50.7% of seroprotected recipients. In the adjusted model, no variable was independently associated with non-seroprotection. Each 10-year increase in age was associated with higher, but not statistically significant, odds of non-seroprotection (aOR, 1.44; 95% CI, 0.96-2.16; p=0.079). Conclusions: Nearly one-third of vaccinated kidney transplant recipients lacked serological protection against HBV. Routine post-vaccination anti-HBs testing and individualized booster or revaccination strategies should be considered, particularly for older recipients and those who have received fewer vaccine doses.
journal: International Journal of Research in Medical Sciences

analysis.research_question_and_background: Evidence regarding post-vaccination hepatitis B virus (HBV) seroprotection among kidney transplant recipients in Saudi Arabia remains limited, prompting the need to estimate seroprotection prevalence and identify factors associated with vaccine nonresponse.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This single-center retrospective cohort study included 100 adult kidney transplant recipients followed at Prince Sultan Military Medical City, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, who had documented hepatitis B vaccination and subsequent quantitative measurement of antibodies to hepatitis B surface antigen (anti-HBs).
analysis.methods: Seroprotection was defined as an anti-HBs concentration of at least 10 mIU/ml, participant characteristics were compared by seroprotection status, and multivariable logistic regression evaluated associations between non-seroprotection and total number of hepatitis B vaccine doses.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study from Saudi Arabia assessed post-vaccination hepatitis B virus (HBV) seroprotection among 100 adult kidney transplant recipients. It found that 69% achieved seroprotection (anti-HBs ≥10 mIU/ml), while 31% remained non-seroprotected. Vaccine dose category differed significantly by seroprotection status, with fewer doses associated with non-seroprotection. No variables were independently associated with non-seroprotection in adjusted models, though older age showed a non-significant trend toward higher odds. The authors recommend routine post-vaccination anti-HBs testing and individualized booster or revaccination strategies, particularly for older recipients and those with fewer vaccine doses. The single-center retrospective design and absence of independent associations limit causal inference and generalizability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 关于沙特阿拉伯肾移植受者 疫苗接种 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 血清保护作用的证据仍然有限,提示需要估计 患病率 血清保护作用并确定与 疫苗 无反应相关的因素。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项单中心回顾性 队列研究 研究纳入了沙特阿拉伯利雅得苏丹王子军事医学城的 100 名成年肾移植受者,他们记录了乙型肝炎 队列研究 以及随后对乙型肝炎表面抗原(抗 HBs)抗体的定量测量。
elements_zh.methods: 血清保护被定义为抗-HBs浓度至少为10 mIU/ml,通过血清保护状态比较参与者特征,多变量逻辑回归评估非血清保护与乙型肝炎疫苗剂量总数之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: 在100名受者中,69名达到血清保护(69.0%;95%置信区间,59.4-77.2%),而31名未达到血清保护;疫苗剂次类别在血清保护状态上存在显著差异(p=0.014),其中未达到血清保护的受者中有80.6%仅接种1至2剂,而达到血清保护的受者中有50.7%接种1至2剂。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解读为,近三分之一的肾移植受者缺乏针对 HBV 的血清学保护,这凸显了 疫苗接种 后常规抗 HBs 检测和个体化加强疫苗或重新疫苗接种策略的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,应考虑常规 疫苗接种 后抗 HBs 检测和个体化加强免疫或重新接种策略,特别是对于老年受者和接受较少 疫苗 剂量的人。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 单中心回顾性设计和调整模型中缺乏独立关联限制了因果推断和普遍性,需要中等强度的证据。

title_zh: 沙特阿拉伯肾移植受者 疫苗接种 后乙型肝炎血清保护:一项回顾性 队列研究 研究
source_body_en: Background: Evidence regarding post-vaccination hepatitis B virus (HBV) seroprotection among kidney transplant recipients in Saudi Arabia remains limited. This study estimated the prevalence of seroprotection and evaluated factors associated with vaccine nonresponse. Methods: This single-center retrospective cohort study included adult kidney transplant recipients followed at Prince Sultan Military Medical City, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, who had documented hepatitis B vaccination and subsequent quantitative measurement of antibodies to hepatitis B surface antigen (anti-HBs). Seroprotection was defined as an anti-HBs concentration of at least 10 mIU/ml. Participant characteristics were compared according to seroprotection status. Multivariable logistic regression was used to evaluate associations between non-seroprotection and total number of hepatitis B vaccine doses. Results: Among 100 kidney transplant recipients, the mean (SD) age was 41.4 (15.2) years, and 66 participants (66.0%) were male. Overall, 69 recipients achieved seroprotection (69.0%; 95% CI, 59.4-77.2%), whereas 31 (31.0%) remained non-seroprotected. Vaccine dose category differed significantly by seroprotection status (p=0.014); 80.6% of non-seroprotected recipients had received only 1 to 2 doses compared with 50.7% of seroprotected recipients. In the adjusted model, no variable was independently associated with non-seroprotection. Each 10-year increase in age was associated with higher, but not statistically significant, odds of non-seroprotection (aOR, 1.44; 95% CI, 0.96-2.16; p=0.079). Conclusions: Nearly one-third of vaccinated kidney transplant recipients lacked serological protection against HBV. Routine post-vaccination anti-HBs testing and individualized booster or revaccination strategies should be considered, particularly for older recipients and those who have received fewer vaccine doses.

title: Revisiting the Gray Zone in HBeAg-Negative Chronic Hepatitis B: Insights From a Multicenter Liver Biopsy Cohort
abstract: Background/Aims: The management of patients with HBeAg-negative chronic hepatitis B (CHB) with intermediate viremia and persistently normal alanine aminotransferase (ALT) levels remains controversial. This “gray-zone” (GZ) population may harbor significant histological liver injury despite not meeting conventional treatment criteria. This study characterized the histologic features of this GZ population and compared their clinical and laboratory characteristics. Materials and Methods: In this multicenter retrospective study, patients with HBeAg negative CHB who had hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA levels between 2000 and 20 000 IU/mL and persistently normal ALT levels and who underwent liver biopsy between 2014 and 2022 were included. Histological assessment was performed using the modified Ishak scoring system. Significant fibrosis was defined as Ishak stage of 2 or greater. Clinical, virological, and noninvasive fibrosis parameters were analyzed. Results: A total of 145 patients were included (mean age: 46.3 ± 12.6 years; 54.5% female). Significant fibrosis and/or moderate-tosevere necroinflammatory activity requiring antiviral therapy was identified in 109 patients (75.1%). Although ALT and aspartate aminotransferase levels remained within normal reference range, both were significantly higher in the treatment group compared than in the nontreatment group (P = .003 and P = .018, respectively). Aspartate aminotransferase-to-platelet ration index (APRI) scores were also significantly elevated among treated patients (P = .02), whereas Fibrorsis-4 (FIB-4) scores did not differ significantly. HBV DNA and quantitative Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) levels were comparable between groups. Conclusion: A substantial proportion of patients with HBeAg-negative CHB in the GZ exhibited clinically significant histologic disease despite persistently normal ALT levels. Reliance solely on conventional biochemical thresholds may underestimate the burden of fibrosis. Early histological evaluation and more proactive treatment strategies should be considered for selected patients in the GZ. Cite this article as: Gül Ö, Köseoğlu H, Yalçın S, et al. Revisiting the gray zone in HBeAg negative chronic hepatitis B: Insights from a multicenter liver biopsy cohort. Turk J Gastroenterol. Published online August 11, 2026. doi: 10.5152/tjg.2026.26367.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the management of HBeAg-negative chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients with intermediate viremia and persistently normal ALT levels, a population referred to as the "gray zone" (GZ). This “gray-zone” (GZ) population may harbor significant histological liver injury despite not meeting conventional treatment criteria. This study characterized the histologic features of this GZ population and compared their clinical and laboratory characteristics. Materials and Methods: In this multicenter retrospective study, patients with HBeAg negative CHB who had hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA levels between 2000 and 20 000 IU/mL and persistently normal ALT levels and who underwent liver biopsy between 2014 and 2022 were included. Histological assessment was performed using the modified Ishak scoring system. Significant fibrosis was defined as Ishak stage of 2 or greater. Clinical, virological, and noninvasive fibrosis parameters were analyzed. Results: A total of 145 patients were included (mean age: 46.3 ± 12.6 years; 54.5% female). Significant fibrosis and/or moderate-tosevere necroinflammatory activity requiring antiviral therapy was identified in 109 patients (75.1%). HBV DNA and quantitative Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) levels were comparable between groups. Conclusion: A substantial proportion of patients with HBeAg-negative CHB in the GZ exhibited clinically significant histologic disease despite persistently normal ALT levels. Reliance solely on conventional biochemical thresholds may underestimate the burden of fibrosis. title: Quantitative HBsAg as a biomarker for disease staging in untreated chronic hepatitis B patients: a cross-sectional study
abstract: Background and aims Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a major issue in North Africa, where HBeAg-negative profiles are predominant. Distinguishing between chronic infection and active chronic hepatitis using conventional markers is sometimes difficult. Our study assessed the correlation of HBsAg with viral load and liver fibrosis, as well as its performance in distinguishing the different evolving phases of chronic HBV infection. Approach and results We conducted an analytical cross-sectional study that included 90 HBeAg-negative treatment-naïve patients. All patients underwent biological assessment, HBsAg quantification, viral load, and FibroScan®. Among the 90 patients (mean age: 47.5 ± 11 years; 52.6% women), 65.6% were in the low-replicative chronic infection phase. The median viral load was 328.5 IU/mL, and the median HBsAg level was 213.5 IU/mL. A strong positive correlation was observed between HBsAg and HBV DNA levels ( r = 0.721, p < 0.001). HBsAg levels showed a weak but significant association with liver fibrosis ( p = 0.007, AUC = 0.631). The performance of HBsAg in differentiating low versus high replicative phases was excellent (AUC = 0.819; p < 0.001), with an optimal threshold of 450 IU/mL (sensitivity: 81.3%; specificity: 77.6%). In multivariate analysis, HBV DNA and AST were independently associated with disease phase, whereas qHBsAg was not an independent predictor. Conclusion Quantitative HBsAg measurement is a relevant tool for refining the stratification of untreated HBeAg-negative patients as a complementary surrogate marker. When combined with viral load, transaminases, and FibroScan®, HBsAg could contribute to optimized monitoring and better resource allocation.

Distinguishing between chronic infection and active chronic hepatitis using conventional markers is sometimes difficult. Our study assessed the correlation of HBsAg with viral load and liver fibrosis, as well as its performance in distinguishing the different evolving phases of chronic HBV infection. Approach and results We conducted an analytical cross-sectional study that included 90 HBeAg-negative treatment-naïve patients. All patients underwent biological assessment, HBsAg quantification, viral load, and FibroScan®. Among the 90 patients (mean age: 47.5 ± 11 years; 52.6% women), 65.6% were in the low-replicative chronic infection phase. The median viral load was 328.5 IU/mL, and the median HBsAg level was 213.5 IU/mL. A strong positive correlation was observed between HBsAg and HBV DNA levels ( r = 0.721, p < 0.001). HBsAg levels showed a weak but significant association with liver fibrosis ( p = 0.007, AUC = 0.631). The performance of HBsAg in differentiating low versus high replicative phases was excellent (AUC = 0.819; p < 0.001), with an optimal threshold of 450 IU/mL (sensitivity: 81.3%; specificity: 77.6%). In multivariate analysis, HBV DNA and AST were independently associated with disease phase, whereas qHBsAg was not an independent predictor. Conclusion Quantitative HBsAg measurement is a relevant tool for refining the stratification of untreated HBeAg-negative patients as a complementary surrogate marker. When combined with viral load, transaminases, and FibroScan®, HBsAg could contribute to optimized monitoring and better resource allocation.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection poses a significant public-health burden in North Africa where HBeAg-negative profiles predominate, and conventional markers sometimes fail to distinguish chronic infection from active chronic hepatitis.
analysis.study_design_and_population: An analytical cross-sectional study enrolled 90 HBeAg-negative, treatment-naïve patients (mean age 47.5 ± 11 years; 52.6% women) and performed biological assessment, HBsAg quantification, viral load measurement, and FibroScan®.
analysis.methods: HBsAg and HBV DNA were quantified, and liver fibrosis was assessed by FibroScan®; correlation and diagnostic performance were evaluated using statistical tests and receiver operating characteristic analysis.
analysis.main_results: HBsAg showed a strong positive correlation with HBV DNA (r = 0.721, p < 0.001), a weak but significant association with liver fibrosis (p = 0.007, AUC = 0.631), and excellent performance in differentiating low- versus high-replicative phases (AUC = 0.819, p < 0.001) with an optimal threshold of 450 IU/mL (sensitivity 81.3%, specificity 77.6%).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret quantitative HBsAg as a relevant complementary surrogate marker for refining stratification of untreated HBeAg-negative chronic HBV patients, highlighting its added value when combined with viral load, transaminases, and FibroScan®.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that HBsAg quantification could improve monitoring strategies and resource allocation in chronic HBV infection management.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The cross-sectional design and single-centre setting limit causal inference and generalisability, warranting prospective validation; overall evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study in 90 HBeAg-negative, treatment-naïve chronic HBV patients assessed quantitative HBsAg as a biomarker for disease staging. HBsAg correlated strongly with HBV DNA (r = 0.721, p < 0.001) and weakly with liver fibrosis (AUC = 0.631), while showing excellent discrimination between low- and high-replicative phases (AUC = 0.819) at a threshold of 450 IU/mL (sensitivity 81.3%, specificity 77.6%). Multivariate analysis indicated HBV DNA and AST, but not HBsAg, were independent predictors of disease phase. The authors conclude that quantitative HBsAg is a relevant complementary tool for stratifying untreated HBeAg-negative patients, potentially improving monitoring and resource allocation when combined with viral load, transaminases, and FibroScan®. The single-centre, cross-sectional design limits causal inference and generalisability, yielding moderate-strength evidence.

title: Tenofovir Alafenamide Versus Entecavir as Switch Therapy After Tenofovir Disoproxil Fumarate in Patients with Chronic Hepatitis B
abstract: Background: Tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) and entecavir (ETV) are recommended alternatives to tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) for patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) at increased risk of kidney injury. However, data from direct head-to-head comparisons of their long-term renal safety and antiviral efficacy after switching from TDF are lacking. We aimed to compare these outcomes between TAF and ETV. Methods: This multicenter retrospective cohort study included consecutive CHB patients who switched from TDF to either TAF or ETV between January 2012 and December 2021. Inverse probability of treatment weighting using the propensity score was applied to balance the baseline characteristics. Changes in estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) were assessed using a linear mixed-effects model. Renal dysfunction was defined as a decline of at least one GFR category. Results: A total of 235 patients were included (TAF, n = 168; ETV, n = 67). After adjustment for key risk factors, the mean eGFR decline over 36 months was not significantly different between the TAF and ETV groups (−3.21 mL/min/1.73 m2 [95% CI, −4.98 to −1.44] vs. −3.49 mL/min/1.73 m2 [95% CI, −9.49 to −2.50]; p = 0.856). The 3-year cumulative incidence of renal dysfunction was also not significantly different between groups (16.6% [95% CI, 10.5–23.3] vs. 7.8% [95% CI, 2.7–16.2]; p = 0.135). Alanine aminotransferase normalization rates (83.0% vs. 78.8%; p = 0.575) and virological suppression rates (97.8% vs. 97.1%; p = 1.000) were similarly high in both groups. Conclusions: TAF and ETV demonstrated similar long-term renal safety and antiviral efficacy, supporting both agents as reasonable switch options for CHB patients requiring TDF discontinuation because of renal safety concerns.

title: Knowledge of Hepatitis B Infection Vaccination Status, Risk Perception and Barriers among Hospital Cleaners at the University of Abuja Teaching Hospital Gwagwalada, Nigeria
abstract: Abstract Background Hospital cleaners occupy a frontline position in healthcare infection control, yet remain among the least studied occupational groups in hepatitis B research. This study assessed knowledge of hepatitis B infection and its vaccine, risk perception, vaccination status, and barriers to vaccination among cleaners at the University of Abuja Teaching Hospital (UATH), Gwagwalada, Nigeria. Methods A descriptive cross-sectional study was conducted among 145 cleaners selected by systematic random sampling. Data were collected using a structured, interviewer-administered questionnaire covering sociodemographic characteristics, hepatitis B knowledge, risk perception, vaccination status, and barriers to vaccination. Analysis was performed with SPSS version 23, using descriptive statistics and chi-square tests. Ethical approval was obtained from the Health Research Ethics Committee of UATH. Results All 145 questionnaires were returned (response rate 100%). Mean age was 40.63 ± 9.96 years; 73.1% were female. Knowledge of hepatitis B was good in 135 participants (93.1%), and knowledge of the hepatitis B vaccine was good in 111 (76.6%). Good risk perception was recorded in 106 participants (73.1%). Despite this, only 49 cleaners (33.8%) had received at least one vaccine dose, and only 19 (13.1%) had completed the full three-dose series. Among those incompletely or unvaccinated, lack of awareness (66.2%), absence of an appropriate hospital vaccination policy (57.9%), inadequate orientation for new staff (53.8%), and unaffordability (37.2%) were the principal barriers identified. Years of work experience (p = 0.005) and age (p = 0.023) were significantly associated with vaccination status. Conclusion Despite generally adequate knowledge and risk awareness, hepatitis B vaccination coverage among hospital cleaners at UATH remains critically low. Systemic institutional shortcomings, particularly the absence of enforceable vaccination policies and structured orientation programs, are more proximate barriers than individual knowledge gaps. Targeted policy reform and workplace vaccination programs are urgently needed.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估尼日利亚瓜瓦拉达阿布贾大学教学医院的医院清洁工对乙型肝炎感染及其 疫苗 的了解、风险认知、疫苗接种 状态以及 疫苗接种 的障碍。医院清洁工在医疗保健感染控制中处于前线地位,但仍然是乙型肝炎研究中研究最少的职业群体之一。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对尼日利亚瓜瓦拉达阿布贾大学教学医院通过系统随机抽样选出的 145 名清洁工进行了一项描述性横断面研究。共收回 145 份问卷,平均年龄为 40.63 ± 9.96 岁,其中 73.1% 为女性。
elements_zh.methods: 使用结构化、访谈员管理的问卷收集数据,涵盖社会人口学特征、乙型肝炎知识、风险认知、疫苗接种 状态以及 疫苗接种 障碍。使用 SPSS 23 版进行分析,使用描述性统计和卡方检验。
elements_zh.main_results: 135 名参与者 (93.1%) 的乙型肝炎知识良好,111 名参与者 (76.6%) 的乙型肝炎 疫苗 知识良好。106 名参与者 (73.1%) 具有良好的风险认知。尽管如此,只有 49 名清洁工 (33.8%) 至少接受了一剂 疫苗,并且只有 19 名 (13.1%) 完成了完整的三剂系列。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 工作经验年数 (p = 0.005) 和年龄 (p = 0.023) 与 疫苗接种 状态显着相关。该研究强调需要进行有针对性的政策改革和工作场所 疫苗接种 计划,以提高乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 的覆盖率。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了解决系统性制度缺陷的重要性,例如缺乏可执行的 疫苗接种 政策和结构化的定向计划,以加强医院清洁工的乙型肝炎预防工作。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于抽象分析,由于缺乏详细的统计分析以及基于问卷的数据可能存在自我报告偏差,因此证据强度中等。

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 医院清洁工在医疗保健感染控制中处于前线地位,但仍然是乙型肝炎研究中研究最少的职业群体之一。本研究评估了尼日利亚瓜瓦拉达阿布贾大学教学医院 (UATH) 清洁工对乙型肝炎感染及其 疫苗 的了解、风险认知、疫苗接种 状况以及 疫苗接种 的障碍。方法对通过系统随机抽样抽取的145名清洁工进行描述性横断面研究。使用结构化、访谈员管理的问卷收集数据,涵盖社会人口学特征、乙型肝炎知识、风险认知、疫苗接种 状态以及 疫苗接种 障碍。使用 SPSS 23 版进行分析,使用描述性统计和卡方检验。获得了 UATH 健康研究伦理委员会的伦理批准。结果 145份问卷全部收回(有效率为100%)。平均年龄为 40.63 ± 9.96 岁;73.1%为女性。135 名参与者 (93.1%) 的乙型肝炎知识良好,111 名参与者 (76.6%) 的乙型肝炎 疫苗 知识良好。106 名参与者 (73.1%) 具有良好的风险认知。尽管如此,只有 49 名清洁工 (33.8%) 至少接受了一剂 疫苗,并且只有 19 名 (13.1%) 完成了完整的三剂系列。在那些不完全或未接种疫苗的人中,缺乏认识(66.2%)、缺乏适当的医院 疫苗接种 政策(57.9%)、新员工培训不足(53.8%)和负担不起(37.2%)是确定的主要障碍。工作经验年数 (p = 0.005) 和年龄 (p = 0.023) 与 疫苗接种 状态显着相关。结论 尽管普遍具备足够的知识和风险意识,UATH 医院清洁工的乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 覆盖率仍然极低。系统性制度缺陷,特别是缺乏可执行的 疫苗接种 政策和结构化的定向计划,是比个人知识差距更直接的障碍。迫切需要有针对性的政策改革和工作场所 疫苗接种 计划。

title: Determinants of Hepatitis B Vaccination Uptake and Hepatitis B and C Preventive Practices Among Healthcare Workers in Tertiary Health Institutions in the Federal Capital Territory, Abuja, Nigeria
abstract: Objectives: This study determined the determinants of Hepatitis B vaccination uptake and Hepatitis B and C preventive practices among healthcare workers in tertiary health institutions in the Federal Capital Territory, Abuja, Nigeria.  Methods: A descriptive cross-sectional study design, mixed methods was adopted. A multi-stage sampling technique was used to recruit 385 healthcare workers from selected tertiary health institutions in the FCT. Data were collected using a pre-tested, self-administered, structured questionnaire. Data were analysed using IBM SPSS version 25.0. Frequencies and proportions were computed for categorical variables.
journal: International Journal of Innovative Science and Research Technology

title: A First-in-Human study of AHB-137, an unconjugated antisense oligonucleotide, in healthy subjects and patients with chronic hepatitis B
abstract: Background & Aims: AHB-137 is a novel ASO targeting a conserved region near the 3′ end of all HBV mRNA. This first-in-human phase 1 study evaluated the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics (PK), and antiviral efficacy in healthy subjects and chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients. Methods: Forty healthy subjects were randomized into four placebo-controlled single ascending dose (100-450 mg, 6:2 AHB-137:placebo) cohorts and one multiple-dose (MD; 300 mg, 6:2) cohort receiving four weekly subcutaneous doses with a Day 4 loading dose (5 doses). Twenty-four virally suppressed, HBeAg-negative CHB patients on stable nucleos(t)ide analogue therapy were enrolled: four in an open-label 300-mg MD cohort (5 doses) and 20 in two placebo-controlled 300-mg MD cohorts (4:1, stratified by baseline HBsAg), receiving an additional loading dose on Day 11 (6 doses). Results: Treatment-related adverse events occurred in 73% of healthy subjects and 71% of CHB patients and were primarily mild or moderate injection-site reactions and headaches. No treatment-related serious adverse events, discontinuations, or deaths were observed. PK profiles showed rapid absorption (T max 2.96-5.50 h), dose-proportional exposure, no significant accumulation, long terminal half-life (150-220 h), and minimal renal excretion. In CHB patients, AHB-137 treatment led to a rapid HBsAg decline (mean 0.7-1.0 log 10 IU/mL). HBsAg loss ( Conclusions: In this Phase 1 study, AHB-137 demonstrated an acceptable safety profile, predictable PK, and rapid and prolonged HBsAg reductions, supporting further evaluation of dosing and treatment duration in CHB.

title: Peripheral Blood Immunogenomic Cytokine-receptor Signature (CXCR1, IL11RA, IL13RA2, CD19) Predicts HBV-related Cirrhosis: Public PBMC Transcriptome Mining and Nomogram Development
abstract: Progression from chronic hepatitis B (CHB) to cirrhosis is closely associated with immune dysregulation and altered cytokine signaling, yet effective noninvasive immune biomarkers remain limited. This study aimed to develop a peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC)-based cytokine gene signature for predicting HBV-related cirrhosis. The GSE114783 microarray dataset was analyzed to identify differentially expressed genes between CHB and cirrhosis. Immune-related candidate genes were selected by integrating curated immune resources and the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes cytokine-cytokine receptor interaction pathway. Least absolute shrinkage and selection operator regression and multivariable logistic regression were used to construct the predictive model. Receiver operating characteristic analysis, leave-one-out cross-validation, and nomogram development were performed to evaluate model performance and support clinical translation. Differential expression analysis identified 3169 genes distinguishing cirrhosis from CHB, from which 86 immune/cytokine-related genes were prioritized. LASSO selected a parsimonious 4-gene signature-CXCR1, IL11RA, IL13RA2, and CD19-capturing key immune axes relevant to chronic inflammation and fibrogenesis (chemokine receptor signaling, IL-11/IL-13 receptor pathways, and B-cell–associated immunity). The resulting model achieved an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.935 (95% CI, 0.882-0.988); at an optimal cutoff of 0.832, sensitivity was 88.6% and specificity 84.3%. LOOCV supported robust performance, and the nomogram demonstrated good agreement between predicted and observed risk. A PBMC-based immune cytokine-receptor gene signature (CXCR1/IL11RA/IL13RA2/CD19) provides a noninvasive tool for immunologically informed risk stratification of HBV-related cirrhosis and may support immune monitoring and early intervention strategies. Prospective, multicohort validation and mechanistic studies are warranted.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 进展为肝硬化与免疫失调和细胞因子信号传导改变有关,但用于风险分层的非侵入性免疫生物标志物仍然很少。该研究通过寻找基于外周血单核细胞 (PBMC) 的细胞因子基因特征来预测 HBV 相关肝硬化,从而弥补了知识差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了 GSE114783 微阵列数据集,以确定 CHB 和 HBV 相关肝硬化之间的差异表达基因。它使用免疫相关候选基因选择,整合策划的免疫资源和 KEGG 细胞因子-细胞因子受体相互作用途径。
elements_zh.methods: 差异表达分析确定了 3169 个区分肝硬化和 CHB 的基因,其中优先考虑了 86 个免疫/细胞因子相关基因。使用 LASSO 回归和多变量逻辑回归构建预测模型,然后进行接受者操作特征分析、留一法交叉验证和列线图开发来评估性能。
elements_zh.main_results: 所构建的模型达到的曲线下面积(AUC)为0.935(95%置信区间,0.882-0.988);在最优截点0.832时,敏感性为88.6%,特异性为84.3%。留一法交叉验证支持模型性能稳健,且列线图显示预测风险与观察风险间具有良好的一致性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将 4 基因特征(CXCR1、IL11RA、IL13RA2、CD19)解释为捕获与慢性炎症和纤维发生相关的关键免疫轴,代表了一种用于对 HBV 相关肝硬化进行免疫学知情风险分层的无创工具。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 基于 PBMC 的免疫细胞因子受体基因特征可能支持 HBV 相关肝硬化的免疫监测和早期干预策略,为临床实践中的风险分层提供无创方法。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究由于依赖单一公共数据集且缺乏前瞻性、多队列验证而受到限制,需要进一步研究以确认普遍性和临床实用性。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了 GSE114783 微阵列数据集,以确定 CHB 和 HBV 相关肝硬化之间的差异表达基因。它使用免疫相关候选基因选择,整合策划的免疫资源和 KEGG 细胞因子-细胞因子受体相互作用途径。
analysis_zh.methods: 差异表达分析确定了 3169 个区分肝硬化和 CHB 的基因,其中优先考虑了 86 个免疫/细胞因子相关基因。使用 LASSO 回归和多变量逻辑回归构建预测模型,然后进行接受者操作特征分析、留一法交叉验证和列线图开发来评估性能。
analysis_zh.main_results: 所构建的模型达到的曲线下面积(AUC)为0.935(95%置信区间,0.882-0.988);在最优截点0.832时,敏感性为88.6%,特异性为84.3%。留一法交叉验证支持模型性能稳健,且列线图显示预测风险与观察风险间具有良好的一致性。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将 4 基因特征(CXCR1、IL11RA、IL13RA2、CD19)解释为捕获与慢性炎症和纤维发生相关的关键免疫轴,代表了一种用于对 HBV 相关肝硬化进行免疫学知情风险分层的无创工具。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 基于 PBMC 的免疫细胞因子受体基因特征可能支持 HBV 相关肝硬化的免疫监测和早期干预策略,为临床实践中的风险分层提供无创方法。

title: Risk factors for low-level viremia in tenofovir disoproxil fumarate-treated chronic hepatitis B patients with advanced hepatic fibrosis/compensated cirrhosis
abstract: BACKGROUND Patients diagnosed with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) complicated by advanced hepatic fibrosis/compensated cirrhosis face a significant risk of disease progression. Despite first-line nucleos(t)ide analog therapy, some patients continues to exhibit low-level viremia (LLV). Furthermore, LLV is closely associated with accelerated liver fibrosis progression and a higher likelihood of hepatocellular carcinoma. Clinical studies on accurate prognostic indicators for LLV in this patient group are still comparatively rare. AIM To identify the high-risk factors linked to the occurrence of LLV among CHB patients with advanced hepatic fibrosis/compensated cirrhosis. METHODS This retrospective study enrolled 141 CHB patients with advanced hepatic fibrosis/compensated cirrhosis who received tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF). Patients were allocated into two groups according to their virological response at week 48 after treatment initiation: LLV, defined as hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA levels of 20-2000 IU/mL, and complete virological response (CVR), defined as HBV DNA levels below 20 IU/mL. Univariate and multivariate logistic regression analysis were carried out to determine risk factors for LLV development. RESULTS A total of 141 patients were included in this study, among whom 17.0% (24/141) developed LLV. Significant differences were identified between the LLV and CVR groups regarding baseline HBV DNA, HBV RNA, hepatitis B e antigen positivity, HBV DNA ≥ 5.0 Log10 IU/mL, 6.0 Log10 IU/mL, 7.0 Log10 IU/mL, HBV RNA ≥ 5.0 Log10 copies/mL, and baseline alpha-fetoprotein. Multivariate logistic regression confirmed that that HBV DNA ≥ 7.0 Log10 IU/mL (OR = 18.824, 95%CI: 1.608-220.404, P = 0.019) at baseline was associated with the occurrence of LLV. CONCLUSION In TDF-treated CHB with advanced hepatic fibrosis/compensated liver cirrhosis, HBV DNA ≥ 7.0 Log10 IU/mL is a high-risk factor associated with LLV.

title: Multi-Mechanistic Treatment Approaches for Hepatitis B and Malaria
abstract: Hepatitis B (HBV) and malaria are highest global challenges for infectious diseases. Both are substantial global health and socioeconomic challenges for higher risks of disease and early death. Cure and therapies are absent and limited. Prolonged treatment regimens are mandated with common suboptimal patient adherence and drug resistance. All underscore the need for newer therapeutic approaches that can achieve durable pathogen control. To this end, we examined the feasibility of combinatorial long-acting (LA) therapeutic approaches to improve the treatment outcomes of chronic HBV (CHB) infection which remains a major risk factor for progressive cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. Although available nucleos(t)ide analog therapies effectively suppress viral replication, they require long-term daily administration. We employed a three-pronged therapeutic strategy using LA prodrug formulations of tenofovir (TFV), a potent nucleos(t)ide analog, and tizoxanide (TIZ), an innate immune enhancer, to sustain viral suppression and improve immune homeostasis. We co-administered LA medicines (termed M5TFV and M2TIZ) in a CHB mouse model. The resulting multi-mechanistic strategy provided sustained antiviral suppression and reduced inflammation and fibrosis. An added part of the dissertation focused on improving limitations in bioavailability, half-life, resistance, and efficacy for existing malaria therapies.

title_zh: 治疗乙型肝炎和疟疾的多机制 治疗 方法
source_body_en: Hepatitis B (HBV) and malaria are highest global challenges for infectious diseases. Both are substantial global health and socioeconomic challenges for higher risks of disease and early death. Cure and therapies are absent and limited. Prolonged treatment regimens are mandated with common suboptimal patient adherence and drug resistance. All underscore the need for newer therapeutic approaches that can achieve durable pathogen control. To this end, we examined the feasibility of combinatorial long-acting (LA) therapeutic approaches to improve the treatment outcomes of chronic HBV (CHB) infection which remains a major risk factor for progressive cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. Although available nucleos(t)ide analog therapies effectively suppress viral replication, they require long-term daily administration. We employed a three-pronged therapeutic strategy using LA prodrug formulations of tenofovir (TFV), a potent nucleos(t)ide analog, and tizoxanide (TIZ), an innate immune enhancer, to sustain viral suppression and improve immune homeostasis. We co-administered LA medicines (termed M5TFV and M2TIZ) in a CHB mouse model. The resulting multi-mechanistic strategy provided sustained antiviral suppression and reduced inflammation and fibrosis. An added part of the dissertation focused on improving limitations in bioavailability, half-life, resistance, and efficacy for existing malaria therapies.
abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎 (HBV) 和疟疾是全球传染病面临的最大挑战。两者都是全球健康和社会经济面临的重大挑战,导致疾病和过早死亡的风险更高。治愈和疗法不存在且有限。延长 治疗 方案通常会导致患者依从性不佳和耐药。所有这些都强调需要能够实现持久病原体控制的新治疗方法。为此,我们研究了组合长效(LA)治疗方法来改善慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)感染的治疗结果的可行性,慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)感染仍然是进行性肝硬化和肝细胞癌的主要危险因素。尽管现有的核苷(酸)类似物疗法可以有效抑制病毒复制,但它们需要长期每日给药。我们采用了三管齐下的治疗策略,使用替诺福韦(TFV)(一种有效的核苷(酸)类似物)和替唑尼特(TIZ)(一种先天免疫增强剂)的LA前药制剂,以维持病毒抑制并改善免疫稳态。我们在 CHB 小鼠模型中共同施用 LA 药物(称为 M5TFV 和 M2TIZ)。由此产生的多机制策略提供了持续的 抗病毒药物 抑制并减少炎症和纤维化。论文的另一部分重点是改善现有疟疾疗法在生物利用度、半衰期、耐药性和功效方面的局限性。

title: Knowledge, Attitude and Preventive Practices Towards Hepatitis B Virus Prevention and Screening: A Community-Based Study in AMAC, Abuja, Nigeria
abstract: Background: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) poses a significant public health challenge globally, particularly in developing countries such as Nigeria. This study assessed the knowledge, attitude, and practice (KAP) of residents in the Abuja Municipal Area Council (AMAC) regarding HBV prevention and screening. Methods: A community-based cross-sectional study was conducted among 401 residents of AMAC. Participants were systematically selected from households in urban and rural areas. Data were collected using a structured, closed-ended questionnaire covering sociodemographic characteristics and KAP regarding HBV. Descriptive and inferential analyses were performed using SPSS version 25. Results: Of the respondents, 51.6% were female and 48.4% were male, with the majority (60.1%) residing in urban areas. The overall knowledge rate was 56.6%, with notable gaps in understanding HBV transmission and prevention. Attitude toward HBV prevention was predominantly positive (68.1%), with strong support for vaccination and healthy practices. The practice rate was 66.4%, indicating good adherence to preventive measures such as vaccination and avoidance of risky behaviors. Significant positive correlations were observed among knowledge, attitude, and practice levels (knowledge-attitude: r = .656, p < .01; attitude-practice: r = .616, p < .01). Factors significantly associated with higher KAP scores included education level, marital status, and age. Conclusion: The findings reveal gaps in HBV-related knowledge, attitudes, and practices. Higher education and positive marital life experiences contribute to better awareness and proactive health behaviors. Public health interventions must address these disparities by promoting comprehensive education and tailored outreach to improve HBV prevention and screening outcomes.

title_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 预防和筛查的知识、态度和预防实践:尼日利亚阿布贾 AMAC 的社区研究
source_body_en: Background: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) poses a significant public health challenge globally, particularly in developing countries such as Nigeria. This study assessed the knowledge, attitude, and practice (KAP) of residents in the Abuja Municipal Area Council (AMAC) regarding HBV prevention and screening. Methods: A community-based cross-sectional study was conducted among 401 residents of AMAC. Participants were systematically selected from households in urban and rural areas. Attitude toward HBV prevention was predominantly positive (68.1%), with strong support for vaccination and healthy practices. Higher education and positive marital life experiences contribute to better awareness and proactive health behaviors. Public health interventions must address these disparities by promoting comprehensive education and tailored outreach to improve HBV prevention and screening outcomes.

title: The Impact of Chronic Hepatitis D Virus Infection on Health-Related Quality of Life and Fatigue: A Real-World International Study.
abstract: As little is known about the disease burden of chronic hepatitis D virus (HDV) infection, this study examined health-related quality of life (HRQoL) and fatigue at different disease stages. This was a real-world quantitative cross-sectional survey of patients in Germany, Italy, Spain and the USA. Patients were recruited via their treating physicians. Patients who had received bulevirtide for hepatitis B or treatment licensed for HDV were excluded. Of 211 patients, 41% were noncirrhotic (F0-F3); 20% had liver cirrhosis with normal function (compensated); 20% had liver cirrhosis (F4) with impaired function (decompensated); 19% had hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Mean (standard deviation; SD) age was 54.5 (11.5) years, 75% were male. ANOVA showed a significant decrease (indicating poorer HRQoL) in EQ-5D-3L visual analogue scale (VAS) scores and index values with worsening disease stage and increasing severity (all p < 0.0001). All domain scores of the Hepatitis Quality of Life Questionnaire v2 (except positive wellbeing) worsened with progressing disease and increasing symptom severity (all p ≤ 0.0001). Mean Fatigue Severity Scale (FSS) total scores also increased, indicating greater fatigue, with worsening of disease and increasing symptom severity (both p < 0.0001). HDV infection significantly impacts patients' HRQoL and fatigue, particularly for patients at later disease stages. Treatments that slow disease progression, reducing the burden of HDV infection, are needed.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis D virus (HDV) infection imposes a poorly understood disease burden, prompting this study to quantify its impact on health-related quality of life (HRQoL) and fatigue across disease stages.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This real-world cross-sectional survey enrolled patients from Germany, Italy, Spain and the USA via treating physicians, excluding those treated with bulevirtide for hepatitis B or HDV-specific therapy.
analysis_en.methods: The study assessed HRQoL using EQ-5D-3L visual analogue scale and index values and the Hepatitis Quality of Life Questionnaire v2, and measured fatigue with the Fatigue Severity Scale, comparing outcomes by disease stage.
analysis_en.main_results: ANOVA revealed significantly lower EQ-5D-3L scores and index values with worsening disease stage (all p < 0.0001), and all Hepatitis Quality of Life Questionnaire v2 domain scores except positive wellbeing declined with increasing severity (all p ≤ 0.0001).
